approvedFacts.text: Artist: Wolfmother · Title: Woman · Album: Wolfmother · Year: 2004 · Genre: Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/TECHNO/Wolfmother - Woman.mp4
"Woman" is a song by Australian rock band Wolfmother.
Originally released in 2004 from their debut EP Wolfmother, it was released in 2006 as the fourth single from their debut studio album Wolfmother.
In Australia, the original recording of the song was ranked number 45 on Triple J's Hottest 100 of 2004.
The discography of Australian hard rock band Wolfmother consists of six studio albums, four extended play (EPs), 18 singles, 14 music videos and one video album.
The band have also contributed to two soundtracks and one tribute album.
Originally from Sydney, Wolfmother were formed in 2004 by vocalist and guitarist Andrew Stockdale, bassist and keyboardist Chris Ross, and drummer Myles Heskett.
